evidence_paraphrase: The public October 2022 arrangements concerned teplizumab co-promotion, financing and negotiation rights, not a definitive acquisition of the issuer. Private strategic discussions continued around the cutoff. The first written nonbinding acquisition proposal was February 14, 2023; the price increased to 25 dollars and private exclusivity followed February 26. Board approval and execution occurred March 12 and the joint public announcement March 13. Two internal year inconsistencies in the original narrative are preserved as source limitations; neither a private meeting nor a historical stock-price comparison establishes an earlier signed or publicly definitive control agreement.
scope: Retrospective agent review of the entire designated original merger-background section including private/public sequencing. Not an exhaustive independent world-news audit, inventory of every later proxy amendment, legal opinion or pre-observation model feature.
